description: One agent-facing entry to the rights-verified bounded external API catalog (Frankfurter, USGS, Crossref and ROR where currently enabled). Read the live catalog to discover available operations. Actions: catalog, execute, batch, resolve, pass_catalog and paid_execute. Free operations remain bounded. A buyer-authorized x402 24h Access Pass supports independently verified paid admission with capped immediate API execution; the MCP tool does not sign, buy, or move funds. It cannot perform purchases, send funds, forward arbitrary URLs or execute upstream fee-bearing APIs. The live catalog combines current first-party products and rights-eligible external operations when independent checks succeed; inventory counts are not hardcoded.

access_key.description: For paid_execute only: the buyer-held 32-byte random access key from an independently confirmed x402 Access Pass. Treat as private; never expose in public logs or chat.

input.description: For currency_rate: base/quote ISO codes; for currency_convert add amount; currency_history add date; USGS operations use empty object; Crossref DOI lookup requires doi, publication search requires query; ROR organization search uses query and ROR record uses id. Always consult the live catalog for exact schemas.

items.description: Each item has operation and input.

operation.description: Use an exact operation name returned by action=catalog. The hub enforces permitted operations, original inputs and per-provider rights before use.

request_id.description: Optional paid_execute logical invocation key. Reuse exactly on retries; a new key refreshes live data. Omission caches identical operation/input per pass.

name: kevaremesh_use_infrastructure
title: One tool to discover or use rights-compatible external APIs
